_comment: Guard-railed autonomous-loop config. Edit numbers here to tune; the loop reads this on every run. Changing this file is safe — it never executes anything.

approval._chatId: machine-specific — lives in the gitignored .loop/channel.local.json (keeps the Apple ID / chat handle out of this public repo)

opportunities._comment: Phase 4 — the OPPORTUNITY SCOUT (scout-opportunities.mjs). Finds value, not just defects. Read-only; writes .loop/opportunities-{inbox.json,digest.md}; applies nothing. Every candidate must clear an evidence gate before it surfaces.
opportunities._croLeakDisabledReason: GA4 events are bot-saturated (68% save/pageview median; keyEvents reads 400% of sessions) and organic traffic is too thin per page (0 pages clear 40 organic pv/28d) to measure per-page conversion. An autonomous CRO detector here would surface inverted noise. Re-enable once organic traffic per page grows AND attribution is bot-filtered — verified empirically 2026-06-07, not a code limitation.

bizOpportunities._comment: Phase 5 — the BUSINESS-OPPORTUNITY SCOUT (bizscout-workflow.js + bizscout-ledger.mjs, driven by /loop-bizscout). Finds NEW businesses for the portfolio, not NakshIQ growth. Harvests live demand signals across many channels, validates + scores each on a 6-factor rubric, fact-checks load-bearing claims, dedupes across runs into a living ledger. Read-only discovery; the iMessage send is gated by autoSend below.
bizOpportunities._channelWeightNote: Channel richness is computed OBJECTIVELY each run by bizscout-ledger.mjs (avg validated composite, penalised for duplicate-flooding) — NOT by a committee guess. Volume never wins. See biz-opportunities-digest.md.

factCheck._note: the top N ledger ideas get an independent primary-source check on their single most load-bearing claim; unverified -> flagged UNVERIFIED, never presented as fact.

bizOpportunities._autoSendNote: false = the scout writes the digest + waits; you review and send. Flip to true ONLY when you want the weekly digest to iMessage you autonomously (a 'send' — gated on purpose per the founder's confirm-before-send rule).
